Hi team,

Quick ask ahead of tomorrow's forecast lock: RevOps pulled an expansion rollup that shows several Aurora upgrade opportunities still in "Proposal" or "Negotiation" with stale ARR and no commit probability. Finance wants a cleaned commit line for next week's board forecast.

Can CS owners please do the following by EOD Friday PDT so we can lock numbers:
- Confirm stage (Qualified / Proposal / Negotiation / Legal) and set a commit probability (25/50/75/90).
- Update the committed ARR number (net of discounts) in HubSpot (link below).
- Attach any outstanding MOAs or signed LOIs to the deal record / drop a stub in the shared folder.

I exported a short CSV with the high-risk upsell opps and attached it here (expansion-opps.csv). Monica — looping you to confirm two opps you co-own; Tessa — please confirm timeline and risk. Vivek, FYI on potential uplift if pricing concession is required.

HubSpot deal link: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/DEAL-4821
Shared folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2b3c-aurora-q3-plan

Thanks — Diego
